summary: The candidate fixes the default scheduler RPC deadline and the basic disaggregated encoder loop, but an independent denoiser-prefetch probe still dispatched a second request after the exact fatal device-not-ready error and never latched fatal state. The reported RTX 5070 MiniMax-H3 memory failure and clean admission/error behavior remain unverified or unresolved.

tests.command: base Python probe of _resolve_timeout_ms/_configure_recv_timeout with a real ZMQ REQ socket
tests.what_was_measured: On recorded base, effective timeout was None and ZMQ RCVTIMEO was -1.
Exact candidate focused regression suite: 216 passed, 16 warnings, 62 subtests passed.

tests.command: independent direct probe of Scheduler._disagg_prefetch_event_loop with two denoiser transfer_compute items
tests.what_was_measured: After r1 raised CUDA driver error: device not ready, r2 was also dispatched and _fatal_error_message remained None.

tests.command: ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 candidate source-import and torch numerical probe
tests.what_was_measured: Candidate modules imported from /job/repo/python; AMD Instinct MI355X ROCm device calculation returned 14.0.
Candidate diff has no whitespace errors.

gpu_execution.evidence: A real tensor calculation ran on AMD Instinct MI355X with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2/HIP 7.2 and returned the independent reference value 14.0; no MiniMax-H3 model execution was possible.

remaining_counterexamples: Disaggregated denoiser/decoder prefetch event loops do not call _handle_execution_error or consult _fatal_error_message; a second denoiser work item was dispatched after CUDA driver error: device not ready.
The candidate does not provide admission-time rejection or a clean insufficient-memory error for the reported 1344x768 request; ordinary OOM remains explicitly non-fatal.
The exact RTX 5070 12 GB / WSL2 / CUDA 13.0 MiniMax-H3 failure and subsequent 480p request remain unverified because that architecture, stack, weights, and LoRA were unavailable.
remaining_limitations: Prepared hardware/software was AMD Instinct MI355X with ROCm 7.2, not RTX 5070 with CUDA 13.0 under WSL2.
MiniMax-H3 weights, FL2VA BF16 setup, and reporter LoRA were unavailable.
No native source changed in the candidate, so native rebuild validation was not applicable.
